name: Seifuku Shinkei Suijaku
original_name: 制服しんけいすいじゃく
source:
I'm Takeshi, otherwise known as "Memory Dude". Day and night, I look for new targets, chasing them around until they play memory with me. If a girl loses, her body's mine. Today's target is...

[Translated from [url=https://elog.tokyo/mini/game_700.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
我叫阿武，人送外号“翻牌达人”。不分昼夜四处物色新猎物的我，只要盯上目标就会死缠烂打逼她们陪我玩记忆翻牌对决——女孩子一旦输掉牌局，她的身体就归我任意摆布。而今天的猎物正是……

[译自[url=https://elog.tokyo/mini/game_700.html]官方网站[/url]]
